cases.name: asweep.translation_center_follows_trajectory
cases.notes: this is what makes the translation animation's moving centre a rendered fact rather than a rendering artefact
cases.reference: the saved bubble centre equals x_s0 + v_s t at every frame

cases.expected_description: centre displacement greater than one bubble radius
cases.name: asweep.lab_frame_field_translates
cases.reference: the laboratory-frame field moves across the domain over the sweep

cases.name: asweep.comoving_profile_stationary
cases.notes: sampled at fixed offsets from the MOVING centre: if the profile changed shape as it moved, this would be nonzero
cases.reference: the comoving shape profile is identical at every frame, so the motion is translation and nothing else

cases.name: asweep.time_values_monotonic
cases.reference: sweep time increases frame to frame

cases.name: asweep.velocity_values_monotonic
cases.reference: sweep velocity increases frame to frame

cases.name: asweep.velocity_sweep_crosses_vf_unity
cases.notes: f(0) = 1 exactly at the bubble centre, so the crossing is exactly at v_s = 1; the committed milestone_03 slice never reaches it, which is why no ergosurface appears in the static figure
cases.reference: the velocity sweep contains a frame where v_s f reaches 1

cases.name: asweep.g00_matches_closed_form
cases.notes: g00 = 0 at v_s f = 1 is therefore an ERGOSURFACE CONDITION, not a degeneracy, a signature failure or a horizon
cases.reference: the saved g00 equals -(1 - v_s^2 f^2) everywhere in the velocity sweep

cases.name: asweep.determinant_is_exactly_minus_one
cases.notes: the (t,x) block determinant is (-1 + v^2 f^2) - (v f)^2 = -1 for ANY v and f, so this is an exact identity rather than a tolerance
cases.reference: det g = -1 across every frame of the velocity sweep, including beyond the crossing

cases.name: asweep.signature_remains_lorentzian
cases.notes: g00 changing sign does NOT change the signature: the eigenvalues of the full 4x4 keep their pattern, which is precisely why the crossing is labelled an ergosurface
cases.reference: the metric stays Lorentzian at every sample, including where g00 >= 0

cases.name: asweep.radius_sweep_center_fixed
cases.notes: this is the case that distinguishes a radius change from a translation in the animation
cases.reference: the bubble centre does not move while the radius is swept

cases.name: asweep.measured_radius_monotonic
cases.notes: measured from the saved profile by bisecting f = 0.5, not read back from the swept parameter, so it is not a tautology
cases.reference: the MEASURED half-height radius increases with R

cases.name: asweep.steepness_sweep_center_fixed
cases.reference: the bubble centre does not move while the steepness is swept

cases.name: asweep.measured_wall_width_monotonic
cases.notes: measured as the separation of the f = 0.75 and f = 0.25 crossings. Larger sigma is a thinner wall, which is the project convention
cases.reference: the MEASURED wall width falls monotonically as sigma rises

cases.name: asweep.nominal_radius_fixed_during_steepness_sweep
cases.notes: the half-height crossing of the Alcubierre shape function is close to but not exactly R, and it shifts slightly as the wall sharpens; the tolerance is that residual shape effect, not a slack allowance
cases.reference: the measured half-height radius stays at the nominal radius while only sigma changes

cases.name: asweep.sensitivity_fields_finite
cases.reference: every exported sensitivity value is finite

cases.name: asweep.oti_matches_analytic_at_center
cases.notes: ties the exported sensitivity field to the same analytic identity the milestone_03 gate checks
cases.reference: dg00/dv = 2 v f^2 = 2 v at the bubble centre, where f = 1

cases.name: asweep.oti_matches_finite_difference
cases.notes: the tolerance is the finite-difference truncation error, not the accuracy of OTI: OTI has no truncation error at all, which is what the milestone_03 convergence study established
cases.reference: the OTI sensitivities agree with centred finite differences at a wall point

cases.name: asweep.fixed_lab_fixed_center_chain_rule
cases.notes: the two conventions come from two metric objects with different sensitivity_mode, never one shared helper; the trajectory term is a centred spatial difference, so its 1e-6 step sets the tolerance
cases.reference: dg/dv|_lab = dg/dv|_centre - (dg/dx) t, with the trajectory term computed independently

cases.name: asweep.output_checksums_valid
cases.reference: every sweep file exists and has a recorded FNV-1a checksum

cases.name: asweep.deterministic_repeat_export
cases.notes: no adaptive stepping, no accumulation, no wall-clock input
cases.reference: frame values and grid coordinates are closed-form functions of their index, so a repeat export is byte-identical

title: A-VISUAL-SWEEP-EXPORT: swept effective-metric fields for the Program A animations, and their scientific assertions
